purpose: Decision team on record keeping after the commander's Ds003 advice: options for how the cockpit keeps brief, current records, and the best one; extended 2026-09-20 after Rq010's approval to the procedures room scaffold (option-maker, adversary), the rule 2 wording check (adversary) and the four stubs (stub-writer)

seats.returns: mechanisms with quotes, URLs, load behaviour

shape: auditor and scout in parallel; option-maker drafts the option space at once and revises when both land; adversary spawned on the final paper
outcome: Decision paper (99 lines) recommending vehicle routing with a drift trigger: procedures behind an imported trigger manifest carry the load, constant rules stay in CLAUDE.md, damage rules go to the guard, records on demand from the wide net with one header line under De021, a periodic currency review. Adversary: 23 findings and nine closing items, all answered, verdict stands. Auto memory and hook enforcement were missing options until the adversary named them. Distilled as Ds004, raised as Rq010. Extended after approval (De022): the adversary checked the pilot's rule 2 and records README wording (seven findings, all taken); stub-writer compressed four drafts into stubs the commander read and the pilot landed (De024); option-maker designed the procedures room scaffold and five starting procedures, one adversary pass (four findings taken, three withdrawn once it saw Or042). Distilled as Ds005; Rq011 approved whole (De025); the manifest is imported into CLAUDE.md and measured live.
lessons: a decision team of auditor, docs scout, option-maker and adversary fits in one evening; the option-maker drafting from the start and revising on the reports saved a round
relay the commander's rulings to every seat at once; messages cross, and a seat working from a stale ruling wastes a pass
the option-maker attacked its own paper while idle and found a staffing defect; say in the brief that this is wanted
the adversary passing residuals ahead of its closing pass let them be closed in the same revision
measure a harness claim the paper depends on while the team works (the @ import test), rather than carrying it as a risk
put the commander's latest order on the subject in every seat's read scope; two adversary findings fell because Or042 was left out of its brief
reusing a live team for the follow-on work (scaffold, wording check) cost no re-briefing; the seats already held the rulings
a stub writer needs the sibling drafts compared for contradiction; the pilot caught one the seat did not
